SUBJECTS_aiwha_wingfirst.lead_html: What you are judging: the Aiwha redraw you asked for by card on 2026-10-14 (Redraw with a wing-first prompt). The wings and the body were generated as separate pieces and joined by a script, so the wingspan is exactly 5.5 body lengths (east). The candidate is the set named render aiwha_wingfirst_composite_v1 (east, south, north): the canon check passed on all three finished pictures, 4/4 each, after four whole-animal tries (the donorport_aiwha sets, shown for the record) had failed on wingspan. The aiwha_wingfirst_wings and aiwha_wingfirst_body sets are only the PIECES the composite was built from; picking one would install a wingless body or a bodiless wing pair. The canvas is the wide 768x384 you chose, so the def's drawSize would become (8,4) when this installs; nothing is installed yet. Skipping the row keeps the donor picture the game shows now.
